import pandas as pd

# --- The employment record as it currently exists on file for EMP-1001 ---
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":    "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":  "Jordan Lee",
    "position":       "Data Analyst",
    "department":     "Analytics",
    "manager":        "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":     pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "effective_date": pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "status":         "Active",
}])

# --- Source artifacts that SHOULD be referenced (lineage targets) ---
required_artifacts = {
    "offer_letter":              "offer_letter_id",
    "signed_employment_agreement": "agreement_id",
    "background_check_report":   "background_check_id",
}

# --- Which lineage fields does the record actually carry? ---
present_cols = set(employment_record.columns)
lineage_report = []
for artifact, field in required_artifacts.items():
    exists = field in present_cols
    value  = employment_record.loc[0, field] if exists else None
    if not exists:
        status = "MISSING FIELD"
    elif pd.isna(value) or value in ("", None):
        status = "FIELD PRESENT BUT EMPTY"
    else:
        status = "LINKED"
    lineage_report.append({
        "source_artifact": artifact,
        "expected_field":  field,
        "field_present":   exists,
        "value":           value,
        "status":          status,
    })

report = pd.DataFrame(lineage_report)

print("=== Lineage Verification: EMP-1001 (Jordan Lee) ===")
print(report.to_string(index=False))

broken = report[report["status"] != "LINKED"]
print(f"\nArtifacts checked : {len(report)}")
print(f"Properly linked   : {(report['status']=='LINKED').sum()}")
print(f"Missing / broken  : {len(broken)}")
if len(broken):
    print("\n>> BROKEN LINEAGE:")
    for _, r in broken.iterrows():
        print(f"   - {r['source_artifact']}: {r['status']} (no '{r['expected_field']}')")
